name: Bite the Hand
source:
A visual novel about offering blood up to get closer to the person you are.

The story of a boy, or a girl, or a person. Who meets with a woman, or a vampire, or...
And the person gets whisked away as a girl. Which is what she always wanted. Or they always wanted to try. Or 
A short 6,000 word story, or wasn't it more like 7,000...
With just the one ending, surely there couldn't be another.

[From [url=https://superbiasedgary.itch.io/bite-the-hand]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于通过献血来接近真实的自己的视觉小说。

一个男孩，一个女孩，或者一个人的故事。谁遇到了一个女人，或者一个吸血鬼，或者……
然后这个人就以女孩的身份被带走了。这是她一直想要的。或者他们一直想尝试。或者 
一个6000字的短故事，或者不是更像7000字……
既然只有一个结局，肯定不可能有另一个结局。

[来自[url=https://superbiasedgary.itch.io/bite-the-hand]itch.io[/url]]
